field.name: id

field.query: SELECT c.id, c.title FROM `j5_content` AS c INNER JOIN j5_categories as cat ON cat. id = c.catid WHERE cat.extension = 'com_content' and cat.title = 'Standard Articles' ORDER BY `id`
